schematic_arrows.status.empty: No targets nearby - check that the schematic is rendered and that you carry the materials
schematic_arrows.status.error: Schematic arrows: could not read the Litematica placement (see log)
schematic_arrows.config.title: Schematic Arrows Settings
schematic_arrows.config.max_arrows.toolt: How many blocks are highlighted at once; the nearest ones win.
How many chunks may be queued for scanning per tick. Higher fills the cache faster.
schematic_arrows.config.scan_radius.tool: Only scan chunks within this many blocks of the player; 0 = the whole placement (default). Cached markers are never removed by leaving the range.
schematic_arrows.config.scan_threads.too: Background worker threads for chunk scanning. Capped at the CPU thread count; 0 scans on the client thread.
schematic_arrows.config.only_selected.to: Only look at the placement currently selected in Litematica.
schematic_arrows.config.arrow_radius.too: Half width of the arrow head, in blocks.
schematic_arrows.config.arrow_height.too: Length of the arrow head, in blocks.
schematic_arrows.config.arrow_stem.toolt: Length of the short line behind the head; 0 leaves just a triangle.
schematic_arrows.config.arrow_gap.toolti: Distance between the arrow tip and the block face, in blocks.
schematic_arrows.config.bob_amplitude.to: How much the arrows breathe up and down; 0 disables the animation.
schematic_arrows.config.line_width.toolt: Pixel width of the arrow lines.
schematic_arrows.config.above_color.tool: Colour of the downward arrow above each block.
schematic_arrows.config.below_color.tool: Colour of the upward arrow below each block.
schematic_arrows.config.draw_box.tooltip: Draw a thin box around every highlighted block.
schematic_arrows.config.box_color.toolti: Colour of that box; it is drawn translucent so it never hides the arrows.
schematic_arrows.config.start_enabled.to: Whether arrows are on right after launching the game. Does not change the current state.
schematic_arrows.config.show_wrong.toolt: Draw an X when the world has a block where the schematic wants a different block or a different state.
schematic_arrows.config.show_extra.toolt: Draw an X when the schematic wants air but the world already has a block there (a printer mis-aimed during lag).
How many wrongly placed blocks are marked at once; the nearest ones win.
Half size of the X marker, in blocks.
schematic_arrows.config.wrong_color.tool: Colour of the X marker for a block that does not match the schematic.
schematic_arrows.config.extra_color.tool: Colour of the X marker for a block that should not be there.
